meta.source: Apple Human Interface Guidelines (macOS 26) — published colours and text styles; materials, radii and control sizes are approximations

tokens.name: window-bg
tokens.usage: Window background (NSColor windowBackgroundColor). Ground for label, label-secondary text.

tokens.name: content-bg
tokens.usage: Content areas: tables, lists, text views, fields (controlBackgroundColor / textBackgroundColor).

tokens.name: content-bg-alt
tokens.usage: Alternating table rows on content-bg.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Liquid Glass regular material: toolbars, sidebars, popovers, menus. Pair with blur-glass backdrop-filter. Approximation — Apple does not publish material values.

tokens.name: glass-clear
tokens.usage: Liquid Glass clear variant over rich media (photos, video). Needs a dimming layer for legibility. Approximation.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Specular rim on glass surfaces: 0.5–1px inset top highlight. Approximation.

tokens.name: glass-stroke
tokens.usage: Outer hairline around floating glass (menus, popovers, sheets).

tokens.name: sidebar-bg
tokens.usage: Floating inset sidebar in macOS 26. Approximation.

tokens.name: menubar-bg
tokens.usage: Transparent menu bar over the desktop. Approximation.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text (labelColor) on window-bg, content-bg, glass.

tokens.name: label-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text (secondaryLabelColor): subtitles, captions, placeholder-like hints. Apple's exact value; light theme is ~3.9:1 on content-bg and ~3.4:1 on window-bg, below 4.5:1 — use for 13px+ supporting text only, never essential copy.

tokens.name: label-tertiary
tokens.usage: Disabled text and placeholder (tertiaryLabelColor). Fails contrast by design: never for information.

tokens.name: label-quaternary
tokens.usage: Watermarks and disabled glyph fills (quaternaryLabelColor). Decorative only.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairline separators between rows, groups and sections (separatorColor).

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Fill of bordered controls: push buttons, pop-ups, steppers, checkbox and radio wells (controlColor).

tokens.name: control-stroke
tokens.usage: Border around control fills and text fields. Approximation.

tokens.name: control-knob
tokens.usage: Switch knob and slider thumb — white in both themes, lifted by shadow-control.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Track fills: slider and progress tracks, switch off-state, segmented-control ground (systemFill).

tokens.name: fill-secondary
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fills for borderless toolbar and sidebar items.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Default app accent: primary button, checked controls, slider fill, focus ring. Follows the user's system accent in a real Mac app.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on accent fills. White on system-blue is 4.0:1 light / 3.6:1 dark — Apple's own pairing, below 4.5:1 for 13px text; keep labels short and Medium weight.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Emphasized selection: selected table and sidebar rows in the key window (selectedContentBackgroundColor). on-accent text on it is 5.3:1 light, 5.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: selection-inactive
tokens.usage: Selection when the window is not key (unemphasizedSelectedContentBackgroundColor). label text on it.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Hyperlinks (linkColor) on content-bg and window-bg: 5.6:1 / 6.2:1.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid outside the control. Apple draws it translucent; this system uses solid system-blue to hold 3:1 on window-bg and content-bg in both themes.

tokens.name: system-red
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, errors, the Close window button family. Pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: system-orange
tokens.usage: Warnings, level-indicator warning zone.

tokens.name: system-yellow
tokens.usage: Highlights, starred and flagged states. Never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: system-green
tokens.usage: Success, on-states in level indicators. Pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: system-mint
tokens.usage: Secondary category colour.

tokens.name: system-teal
tokens.usage: Secondary category colour.

tokens.name: system-cyan
tokens.usage: Secondary category colour.

tokens.name: system-blue
tokens.usage: The default accent; informational states.

tokens.name: system-indigo
tokens.usage: Category colour.

tokens.name: system-purple
tokens.usage: Category colour.

tokens.name: system-pink
tokens.usage: Category colour.

tokens.name: system-brown
tokens.usage: Category colour.

tokens.name: system-gray
tokens.usage: Neutral glyphs and badges; never body text.

tokens.name: badge-red
tokens.usage: Count badges and notification dots with on-accent text (5.6:1). Apple's increased-contrast red; system-red with white is only 3.5:1.

tokens.name: window-close
tokens.usage: Close button of the window controls (traffic lights).

tokens.name: window-minimize
tokens.usage: Minimize button of the window controls.

tokens.name: window-zoom
tokens.usage: Zoom / full-screen button of the window controls.

tokens.name: window-control-inactive
tokens.usage: All three window controls when the window is not key.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimming behind sheets and modal alerts.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro", "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Window-level hero titles, onboarding, empty states.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Sub-section titles, sheet and alert titles at 13pt bold are preferred for alerts.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Emphasised body: alert titles, list row titles, group-box titles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text for controls, labels, table cells, paragraphs.
styles.sample: Choose where downloaded files are saved.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Monospaced values, file paths, keyboard shortcuts in docs.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-text nudges, segment gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside controls; menu vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a checkbox and its label; tight control rows.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Standard gap between adjacent controls; button horizontal padding at small size.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between control groups; button horizontal padding at regular size; list row padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Content padding in popovers, inspectors, group boxes.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Window content margin (HIG).

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Sheet and alert padding; gaps between major sections.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Empty-state and onboarding spacing.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkbox, small badges, table selection highlight.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Menu item highlight, sidebar row highlight, tokens in a token field.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Push buttons, pop-up buttons, text fields, segmented controls at regular size. Approximation.

tokens.name: radius-menu
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips, combo-box lists.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Popovers, sheets, alerts, floating sidebar, grouped lists.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: Window corners in macOS 26 (concentric with toolbar glass). Approximation.

tokens.name: radius-capsule
tokens.usage: Capsule controls: toolbar item groups, switches, badges, search field.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: Raised bordered controls: push buttons, pop-ups, switch knob.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Liquid Glass toolbar groups and sidebar.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips, combo-box lists.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Key windows, sheets and alerts.

size.note: Control heights by control size (NSControl.ControlSize). Approximations for macOS 26.

tokens.name: control-mini
tokens.usage: Mini controls in dense inspectors.

tokens.name: control-small
tokens.usage: Small controls in toolbars-of-panels and inspectors.

tokens.name: control-regular
tokens.usage: Default height for buttons, fields, pop-ups.

tokens.name: control-large
tokens.usage: Large controls; toolbar item groups.

tokens.name: control-xlarge
tokens.usage: Extra-large prominent actions in onboarding and sheets.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur radius for glass, sidebar-bg; combine with saturate(180%).

tokens.name: blur-menu
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur radius for menus and the menu bar.
